issue.title: test_commits_pilot_drives_live_filter_bar_detail_copy_and_toggles fails under the full parallel lane, passes on rerun
issue.description:
`tests/ace/tui/test_commits_pane_interactions.py::test_commits_pilot_drives_live_filter_bar_detail_copy_and_toggles`
fails under the full parallel lane and passes on rerun on the same tree. This is
another node in the `sase-ct` "ACE TUI test fails under the full parallel run,
passes in isolation" class, filed node-specific per that retired umbrella's
close policy.

OBSERVED on master ec048b168 plus a local `tests/_suite_gate.py` module split
(the sase-q7 toobig fix — test-support only, zero `src/sase` changes and zero
ACE/TUI files touched). Because `tests/_suite_gate.py` is a
`ROOT_CONFTEST_PATHS` broadening path, both `just check` runs escalated to the
full suite:

- run 1: `2 failed, 33801 passed, 13 skipped, 45 errors in 529.94s`
- run 2: `2 failed, 33801 passed, 13 skipped in 550.51s`

This node was one of the two failures in run 2 (the other is
`test_ace_page_fast_startup_is_structurally_quiet`, corroborated on `sase-oz`).
The 45 errors in run 1 were all
`tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_vim_normal_key_containment.py`, already owned by
`sase-ni`, and all 45 passed on rerun.

NOT REPRODUCED serially: rerunning this node together with
`test_ace_page_fast_startup_is_structurally_quiet` on the identical tree with
`-p no:randomly` passed in 8.11s (3.89s for this node). So it is parallel-lane
only, same shape as the rest of the class.

FAILURE POINT: the failure lands inside the `async with AcePage(initial_tab="patches")`
body, after `page.press("1")` and `expect_state("artifacts_subtab", "stitches")`,
in the `page.wait_for(...)` chain that waits for `pane.result is result` and then
for `bool(diff_calls)` before reading `#stitches-detail`. Ran on `gw2`. The full
traceback tail was not captured before the log rotated; whoever picks this up
should re-run under `just test-contention` to get a clean capture. Note the test
monkeypatches `commits_module.run_vcs_log` and `commits_module.load_commit_diff_text`
and records the collector's thread id, so a plausible reading is that one of the
two `wait_for` predicates times out under load rather than that the pane produced
a wrong value — but that is a hypothesis, not a measurement.

SCOPE: determine whether this is a bounded-wait-under-load problem in the test
(in which case `tools/check_test_wait_helpers` is the relevant instrument) or a
genuine ordering/state issue in `CommitsPane`'s live filter-bar/detail/copy path.
Prefer a mechanism fix over baselining; if it must be baselined first, the entry
in `tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt` needs this bead named as owner per that
file's header.

Parallel-only; ran on gw2. Not previously recorded: 'sase bead search' over the node ID, CommitsPane, commits_pane, and stitches-detail found no prior task.
